name: @immunity-wars/room
description: Phase 3, P3.1. The room's rules as a pure reducer: no sockets, no clock, no platform.
comment:why-this-package-may-import-the-: It is the authority in multiplayer: it applies actions and projects views, which is what packages/session does on a single device. docs/PHASE3_BRIEF.md §2. It computes what it sends beside each view with @immunity-wars/session-core, the builder LocalSession uses (P3.4). It may NOT reach ui, app, server or session, which room-no-downstream enforces, and it must stay free of platform APIs, which room-no-node-builtins enforces — that rule is Gate B's portability requirement expressed as a check.
